name: Terminal Management Action
definition: Terminal management action to be performed by the point of interaction.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Types of terminal management action to be performed by a point of interaction.

Trigger.name: Trigger
Trigger.definition: Event to start the terminal management action by the point of interaction (POI).

AdditionalProcess.name: Additional Process
AdditionalProcess.definition: Additional process to perform before starting or after the terminal management action by the point of interaction (POI).

TerminalManagementSystem.name: Terminal Management System
TerminalManagementSystem.definition: Terminal management system from which an action took place
